features.focusMode: Focus mode, which leaves only the note on screen
features.contextPanel: The context panel beside the note: its outline, its related notes and its history
features.settingsNav: The settings sidebar, one page per section
features.slashCommands: The / menu in the notes, also on right click: headings, lists, tables, callouts…, in submenus (existing tables and callouts are shown to everyone)
features.codeHighlight: Code blocks colored by their language
features.wordCount: The word count of the note, below the text
features.paletteActions: In the Cmd K palette: move the open note or folder, rename it, change the theme
features.sourceMode: Source mode: the note's markdown as plain text, from the button under the text
features.noteLock: Lock a note read-only, from the padlock under the text

features.brokenLinks: The list of broken or ambiguous links and of missing files, in the settings
features.storageFiles: The list of the files kept on the server, in the Data section of the settings
features.wikiLinks: [[Note]] links to a note or one of its headings ([[Note#Heading]], [[#Heading]]) offered as you type, the linked notes under the text and ![[Note]] to embed a note in another
features.images: Paste or drop images into a note, small, medium or large
features.attachments: Attach a PDF, a zip, a sound or a video to a note, as a link that downloads it
features.linkCards: A web or mail link as a plain link, a mini card or a large card
features.snippets: Snippets inserted with ;; and templates for a new note, set in the settings
features.savedSearches: Smart folders: searches replayed, shown in the sidebar
features.search: Search and the Cmd K palette
features.themes: Color themes, in light and dark mode
features.importExport: Import a zip, .md files or an Obsidian vault; export everything, a folder or a selection
features.trash: The trash, to restore a deleted note or folder
